description: This file defines the Composer ClassLoader class, implementing PSR-0, PSR-4, and classmap autoloading mechanisms for PHP projects. It manages class loading, namespace prefixes, directory mappings, and registration of autoload functions.

classes.name: ClassLoader
classes.description: Implements a PHP autoloader supporting PSR-0, PSR-4, and classmap standards, managing class and namespace mappings, directory registration, and autoload registration.

methods.name: getPrefixes
methods.description: Returns all registered PSR-0 prefixes.

methods.name: getPrefixesPsr4
methods.description: Returns all registered PSR-4 namespace directories.

methods.name: getFallbackDirs
methods.description: Returns fallback directories for PSR-0.

methods.name: getFallbackDirsPsr4
methods.description: Returns fallback directories for PSR-4.

methods.name: getClassMap
methods.description: Returns the class-to-file path map.

methods.name: addClassMap
methods.description: Adds entries to the class map.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Registers PSR-0 directories for a prefix, with optional prepend.

methods.name: addPsr4
methods.description: Registers PSR-4 directories for a namespace, with optional prepend.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets PSR-0 directories for a prefix, replacing existing.

methods.name: setPsr4
methods.description: Sets PSR-4 directories for a namespace, replacing existing.

methods.name: setUseIncludePath
methods.description: Enables or disables searching the include path.

methods.name: getUseIncludePath
methods.description: Checks if include path searching is enabled.

methods.name: setClassMapAuthoritative
methods.description: Sets whether class map is authoritative.

methods.name: isClassMapAuthoritative
methods.description: Checks if class map is authoritative.

methods.name: setApcuPrefix
methods.description: Sets APCu cache prefix if extension is enabled.

methods.name: getApcuPrefix
methods.description: Returns APCu cache prefix or null.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the autoloader with SPL.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the autoloader from SPL.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class by filename if found.

methods.name: findFile
methods.description: Finds the file path for a class.

methods.name: getRegisteredLoaders
methods.description: Returns all registered loaders.

methods.name: findFileWithExtension
methods.description: Finds class file with specific extension, supporting PSR-0 and PSR-4.

methods.name: initializeIncludeClosure
methods.description: Initializes the closure used for including files.
